description: 6 exemplars (one German) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-13 under road-to-skill-scripts-that-run-where-they-land, which rewrote this skill's grounded stack-guidance invocation to the bundled `node <skills-root>/…/ground.mjs` form and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars are the four things its own description names — reactive state, events, lifecycle hooks, and the component/view separation — reached both by naming Livewire and by the symptom phrasing a user actually types, which is that something should change without a page reload. Near-misses are the two boundaries the skill draws for itself (a static Blade view → blade-ui, a Flux primitive → flux) plus the broadcasting infrastructure that shares its real-time vocabulary and is not a component at all. Counterexamples guard the assumption that every task in a Livewire project is a Livewire task, and the word wire as a protocol encoding.

the list should update when the filter changes, without reloading the page
the query is sitting in the view — where does it belong, and which lifecycle hook loads it?
this component re-renders on every keystroke — fix the wire:model binding
the notifications panel should react to an event dispatched from the other component
bau eine Livewire-Komponente für die durchsuchbare Nutzertabelle mit Pagination

use the Flux modal primitive inside this view
